abilities.name: Steady Hands
abilities.description: Once between rests, you may make a Recovery check. Choose one Digimon or Tamer; they heal HP equal to the result of that check.

abilities.name: Extra Dose
abilities.description: Steady Hands' healing also gets +1d8 added to the roll.

abilities.name: Double Charge
abilities.description: Your equipped Gadget's uses are doubled before it needs to refresh at a rest.

abilities.name: Making the Rounds
abilities.description: Steady Hands is no longer limited to one use between rests total. Instead, you may use it once on each Digimon or Tamer between rests, rather than just once overall.

abilities.name: Just In Case
abilities.description: Once between rests, as your Basic Action, declare that you happen to have one Supply item on hand that you hadn't listed before. You must use it immediately, as though you'd been carrying it the whole time.

abilities.name: Better Safe Than Sorry
abilities.description: When Steady Hands restores more HP than the target can recover, the excess becomes Temporary HP instead of being wasted. If the target is already at maximum HP, the entire amount restored by Steady Hands becomes Temporary HP.
